note: key legend -> LED index, read from the firmware's QMK-style g_led_config (1.0.6.6). matrix_co[6][18] u8 at file 0x43FD4 (.data image; RAM 0x200024B4, copied from file 0x43E20 -> RAM 0x20002300 by startup 0x0233C), 0xFF = no LED; point[119] {x,y} u8 at +108 (file 0x44040); flags[119] u8 at +346 (file 0x4412E). Used by the reactive-effect code at 0x09B5C (led = matrix_co[row*18+col], skip 0xFF) and by every renderer via flags[led] (0x15A offset). LEDs 0-98 = the 99 keycap LEDs in physical row-major order (18/18/18/16/17/12 per row), so led == row*18+col only for rows 0-2 and row 3 cols 0-11. LEDs 99-108 = left side light (x=0), 109-118 = right side light (x=224); they are driven only by the separate side-light engine (0x0D5xx-0x0E6xx, set_led loops 99..108 and 109..118) and are never rendered from the 0xD8 custom table (custom renderer 0x0B0B8 clamps to 99), so they cannot be set per-key. Knob (row 6) has no LED -> null. T1 check 2026-09-30: lighting 66,71,89,93,94,96,97 lit ENT, Z, (LCMD not reported), a bottom-row key near FN (table: RCTL), LEFT, RGHT, KP_0; the old row*18+col formula predicted no keys at all for those indices. Lighting 106-118 red showed no red (side-light engine owns them). Rows 0-3 WASD/top-row keypress checks agree with this table.
formula: led = matrix_co[row*18 + col] from firmware file 0x43FD4 (0xFF = none); NOT row*18+col
